comment: The trust-list key chain (P-256 JWKs) every client pins, in order: the key in use, then the next_keys it pre-committed (spec/envelope-format.md §9.2, the key-chain rule: a list signed by a later key wins over any sequence from an earlier one). Sovrasign production's trust-list-1 key (an HSM key in the production Key Vault); kid is its RFC 7638 thumbprint.
